spanish: Y en el día el octavo será circuncidada carne de su prepucio.

findings.issue: Niphal imperfect is 3ms and בשׂר is masculine singular; circuncidada is feminine only so the participle agrees with Spanish carne. Person, number, passive stem, and participant are unchanged.

notes: Y+en+día, el octavo, passive imperfect, and carne de su prepucio match the five tokens.
